method: Static source and archive-member inspection; no sample code executed.

Statically decoded the shared Shai-Hulud rotation table; reviewed credential collection, GitHub output, package republishing and destructive fallback.
Parsed Node PE resources and compared the Authenticode image digest with the embedded signed digest; SEA fuse remains 0 and no payload resource was found.

Reassessed all six previously inconclusive/dual-use artifacts by following source call sites and package activation; compared every byte of the modified Node binary with the checksum-verified official release.
changes: Bound concatenated curl-to-shell initializers to exec arguments, including callback bodies, renamed variables, lexical declarations, comments and absolute shell paths.
Moved whole-environment export from credential values to configuration/environment.
Moved an ordinary GITHUB_PAT read into neutral environment access; kept the downstream repository-agent consumer bound to that capability.
Replaced an unbound local variable named env as environment-access evidence with the canonical process.env JSON capability.
Moved hook/high-major/empty-manifest conjunctions to neutral installation metadata. A major version beginning with nine does not establish an attack.
Moved generic Bun installer, PATH-refresh, sidecar filename, namespace, string-count and helper-name observations into their canonical property/capability homes.
Kept reviewed Shai-Hulud signatures in the family directory, anchored to its Second Coming marker; ordinary silent Bun provisioning stays suspicious.
Required WebSocket/eval-command evidence in one source file before joining a browser host-permission manifest; repository-wide coincidence no longer convicts.
Added proximity to the XHTML frame/active-frame text conjunction and accurately described its text evidence.
Distinguished fenced red-flag examples in security documentation from active persona directives.
Treated Base64 code-layer classification as a neutral format observation, including ordinary inline source maps; language descriptions explicitly state inferred classification.
Reclassified the existing generated import-time OOB fixture from hostile to suspicious.
Treat published import-time OAST beacons as hostile execution probes; retain accurate absence of credential or host-data payloads.
Detect Mythic callback-transfer and payload-build interfaces using actual gql tagged-template operations plus their operator UI context; reject quoted source controls.
Detect load-time DNS execution callbacks alongside host inventory without asserting that an unused inventory string is transmitted.
Detect preinstall host-profile response-to-shell loaders and their actual scoped registry replacement command; bind exec aliases to child_process imports.
Describe the GUI Node runtime with an invalid image digest as suspicious; a full official-binary comparison establishes the exact one-byte header change.

validation.isolation: Starting traits revision 47ea940fea plus the paths in changed-paths.txt. Concurrent Java/Python/PNG edits were excluded after they caused unrelated validation failures.
validation.engine: Built clean cleave HEAD from a temporary source export; the sibling working checkout had unresolved merge conflicts. Shared source files and build target were not changed.
validation.endpoint_reassessment: Passed: 24 controls (including modified and official Node binaries) plus the original 18 controls; results in endpoint-regressions.log and regressions.log.

coverage_notes: Do not create duplicate hostile traits to meet a numerical minimum. Small packages exposing one export mechanism retain one or two supported hostile findings; the four worm carriers retain six hostile findings each.
Two confidently benign archives retain one accurate suspicious finding each: TLS verification disabling in a GraphQL generator, and active-frame strings in bundled DOM parser tests.

Some earlier atomscan runs encountered a transient parse error in an unrelated concurrently edited Python sandbox trait. The isolated final validation loads the complete reviewed trait set; JavaScript controls and final affected-sample rescans passed.

Inline source maps can still become synthetic Base64 source layers, sometimes with an inferred language differing from the original source. Their structural classification is now explicitly neutral rather than an obfuscation claim.

The five source/package artifacts previously excluded as inconclusive or dual-use are now bad after endpoint-oriented behavioral reassessment. Node remains the only inconclusive artifact because its external deployment context is missing.

A digest mismatch is detected independently of successful signer cryptography. Both the existing digest-mismatch trait and the new GUI Node context fire on the modified runtime; neither fires on the official reference.

The complete Node.js 20.20.1 Windows executable matches the official release except for one byte at 0x19c: OptionalHeader.Subsystem changes from console (3) to GUI (2). Reverting that byte reproduces the official SHA-256 exactly. The retained signature has a true image-digest mismatch, detected as suspicious; the GUI-runtime mismatch composite also fires. There is no injected code or embedded SEA payload. The altered runtime can avoid console allocation, but the surrounding launcher or scripts needed to establish its deployment purpose are unavailable.

high_findings.description: GUI Node runtime has an invalid image digest

The npm preinstall hook runs load.js. After probing fixed addresses on TCP 18393, the loader Base64-encodes host/user identity, POSTs it by curl to the reachable address on HTTP 8443 at /setting/profile, and pipes the response into /bin/sh. It then executes tnpm install for the scoped identity package. This install-time remote shell loader and package replacement are sufficiently established without obtaining or executing the remote stage.

high_findings.description: Preinstall profiles host and runs shell stage
